title: Bundled Links Not Passing Traffic After Config
symptoms: Users on the access switch report complete loss of connectivity to the core
The four physical links in the bundle show as up/up individually
The Port-Channel interface shows protocol down
Issue started immediately after adding the second switch to the bundle
rootCause: The EtherChannel member interfaces are using different channel-group modes on each side. One side is set to 'active' (LACP) and the other to 'desirable' (PAgP). The protocols are incompatible, so the bundle never forms.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the EtherChannel summary and its current state?
steps.hint: Look at the flags column - 'SU' means in use, 'P' means bundled.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the running config of a member interface to check its channel-group mode?
steps.hint: Look for the 'channel-group X mode' line - does it match the other side?

steps.prompt: Which command shows the EtherChannel load-balancing method in use?
steps.hint: If the bundle is up but traffic is imbalanced, this is worth checking.
